about.title: Passion - Experience - Diligence
text: Brian Bleifeld CPA and DeeAnn Standlee CPA met at Texas A&M's Bonfire in 1994. Friends from the beginning, Brian and DeeAnn used their education and experience to help worldwide businesses operate in the United States.

Standlee & Bleifeld CPAs PLLC is not the largest firm in Texas, but we think it is one of the best. Our client relationships span decades, not years. The personal accounting firm for countless global citizens and businesses both near and far, we are smart enough to serve you and small enough to care.

Our individual fields complement each other in surprising, and what turned out to be inseparable, ways. Our firm is destined to become one of the most sought-after corporate firms for complex small- to medium-sized businesses.
